The '''Varonat system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Varonat/Legends|Varonat]]. It was situated in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] near the coreward end of the [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Trade Corridor]].
